title: Piano Movers in Long Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Piano movers in Long Beach for Bluff Park stairs and the Bixby Hill gate: four movers on your hourly move and a $200 piano add-on, planned in advance.
heroSubtitle: Book the piano into your Long Beach household move: one hourly job, four movers on the carry, and a $200 add-on in place of a separate delivery.

faq.question: Can four movers get a piano down the stairs of a two-story Bluff Park house?
faq.answer: Yes. Stairs slow the carry but do not rule it out: the piano goes down on a padded board, one step at a time, with two movers on the low end and a pause at each landing. Photos of the staircase, its turns and the front entry let us plan the route before the date, and the crew covers the floors first.

faq.question: My house is inside the Bixby Hill gate. What should I arrange?
faq.answer: Let the guard or the Bixby Hill Community Association know when the truck is coming; we send you the crew size and arrival window to pass on. Should the association require proof of insurance, a $50 Certificate of Insurance from us covers it, sent before the date. Everything else about the piano job stays the same as outside the gate.

faq.question: Where will the truck stop on my residential street?
faq.answer: Long Beach restricts oversized vehicles on residential streets, so we keep curb time short: the piano is wrapped and on its board before the truck pulls up. When you book, tell us about a driveway, an alley or a clear stretch of curb near your door.

faq.question: Is my piano priced separately from the rest of the move?
faq.answer: No. The booking is an hourly move staffed by four movers with a truck, with $200 added for the piano. One 3-hour minimum covers the entire move, and the only other fixed items are a gas fee of $30 and a deposit of $50, which is subtracted from the final bill.

faq.question: Is a same-day piano move possible in Long Beach?
faq.answer: It is, when a four-person crew is still free that day. Crews are out every day of the week from 8AM to 6PM, so call 909-443-0004 early and have photos of the piano and the stairs ready to send.

faq.question: What piano services does SOS leave to others?
faq.answer: Moving is the whole of it: no tuning, no appraisals, no piano storage and no disposal, and no long-distance piano moves either. A tuner of your choosing can come once the piano has had time to acclimatize to its room.
